# I Love Idro

> Authentic experiences at Lake Idro (Lago d'Idro / Idrosee / Idromeer), a pristine mountain lake in Brescia, northern Italy. Personal stories and practical guides for outdoor sports, trekking, local culture and gastronomy. Available in Italian, English, German and Dutch.

## About
- **Website**: https://www.iloveidro.com
- **Location**: Lake Idro, Valle Sabbia, Brescia, Lombardy, Italy
- **Coordinates**: 45.7543°N, 10.5127°E
- **Altitude**: 368m above sea level
- **Author**: Marco, lifelong resident and outdoor enthusiast (kayak, MTB, trekking)
- **Languages**: Italian (it), English (en), German (de), Dutch (nl)
- **Type**: Personal blog — no commercial affiliation, no sponsored content

## Key facts about Lake Idro
- One of the cleanest and least commercialised lakes in northern Italy
- No motorboats allowed — ideal for kayak, SUP, canoe and swimming
- Reliable thermal wind (Ander, blowing from north) ideal for windsurfing and kitesurfing
- Via ferrata routes nearby: Sasse, Crènch
- Surrounded by Dolomite-like peaks (up to 2,200m)
- Popular with Dutch and German tourists since the 1970s
- Nearby destinations: Lago di Garda (40km), Madonna di Campiglio (50km), Dolomiti (90km), Brescia (55km), Milan (130km)
